title: Pyro preview, loop, bake, and flipbook
summary: Turn explicit source fields into a bounded sparse Pyro simulation, optionally create a validated loop, and package a channel-defined engine flipbook.

use_when: smoke or fire must become a volume cache or flipbook
avoid_when: a scene render rather than an engine texture is the requested product

inputs: capture camera, channel packing, and texture contract
acceptance: all channels, tiles, metadata, and color-space settings validate
rollback: write simulation and flipbook to new versions
